responsibility: Defines the core runtime support for Graphite’s in-memory polyhedral representation: creation, ownership, destruction, and debugging/printing of SCoPs, polyhedral basic blocks, and polyhedral data references. It allocates poly_bb/poly_dr/scop objects, records GIMPLE-side black-box information and isl sets/maps such as domains, iterator spaces, and access relations, and provides the print/debug helpers for pbb, pdr, scop, schedules, ASTs, and generic isl objects. This file is the representation-management layer, distinct from detection, conversion, optimization, or code generation passes.
